user.title: Midea water heat pump via red CN30
user.description: Read-only status from the residential red 3-pin wire-controller header (CN30), through an Elfin EW-11 transparent TCP bridge. This is not the Modbus integration. The dongle must stay at 600 8N1, UART protocol NONE, half-duplex, GapTime 1000. Nothing else may own TCP 502. The heater broadcasts one 33-byte frame about every 4 seconds.

reconfigure.title: CN30 bridge
reconfigure.description: The integration checks for one checksum-valid frame before saving. It does not send a command.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the EW-11 TCP port. Check the host, and that the dongle is on the LAN.
error.timeout: The port opened, but no CN30 bytes arrived in 12 seconds. Confirm 600 8N1, UART protocol NONE, and that no other program is connected to port 502.
error.no_frame: Bytes arrived, but none was a checksum-valid 33-byte FE AA frame. Check A/B polarity and that UART protocol is NONE, not Modbus.

abort.already_configured: This EW-11 host is already configured.

init.title: CN30 status
init.description: Entities go unavailable when no valid frame arrives within this many seconds. The heater normally broadcasts about every 4 seconds.

t5c.name: T5L Tank
t5c.description: T5L tank temperature from CN30 byte 16. Byte 23 copies it. Scale (raw * 0.5) - 15.

t3.name: T3 Evaporator
t3.description: T3 evaporator temperature from CN30 byte 15.

t4.name: T4 Ambient
t4.description: T4 ambient temperature from CN30 byte 24.

tp.name: TP Discharge Air
tp.description: TP discharge air from CN30 byte 22 as an unscaled integer °C.

eev.name: EEV
eev.description: Electronic expansion valve opening from CN30 byte 20.

th.name: TH Suction
th.description: TH suction is not a separate byte in the 33-byte CN30 frame.

element.name: Element
element.description: On when CN30 byte 21 is non-zero. That bit tracks the element glyph and can be set while the mode pair is Off.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: On when the timer bit 0x10 is set on mode byte 5 or 6.

keypad_lock.name: Keypad lock bit
keypad_lock.description: Byte 11 bit 0x20. The padlock glyph can stay lit after this bit clears.
